remarks: This newly renovated and spacious unit sits on the interior courtyard of Eastside Commons. About a quarter of a mile from the center of Stamford Downtown, it is walking distance from bars, restaurants and offices. Bright Living Room with beautiful Brazilian Hardwood floors, Kitchen with Granite counters, island and stainless -steel appliances. Bedrooms feature new tile floors and California Closets. Private Balcony adjacent to Living Room and Master Bedroom overlooking Courtyard. Washer & Dryer included in the unit. Secure building with doorman, Gym and one reserved garage parking space.
